infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: StringAI needs camera access to analyze your playing posture and bow technique.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: StringAI needs microphone access to analyze your intonation, tone quality, and rhythm.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: StringAI needs photo library access to let you upload existing practice videos.
infoPlist.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: StringAI uses this to measure which channels bring new violinists to the app. Your practice recordings and results are never shared or sold.
